summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares datopotamab deruxtecan with docetaxel in adults with previously treated, TROP2-positive, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer without certain actionable genomic alterations. Both drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion once every 3 weeks on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle; total duration is not stated. The study will measure efficacy and safety; the specific primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara datopotamab deruxtecan con docetaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón no escamoso de células no pequeñas, previamente tratado, TROP2 positivo, sin ciertas alteraciones genómicas accionables. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) una vez cada 3 semanas, el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días; la duración total no se indica. El estudio medirá la eficacia y la seguridad; el resultado principal específico no se indica.
who_for: Stage IIIB, IIIC, or IV non-squamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations.
TROP2 NMR positive on a prospective central test.
Radiographic progression after platinum chemotherapy plus anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody, as the only one or two prior lines.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 that was not previously irradiated.
not_for: Squamous, mixed NSCLC, or small cell lung cancer histology.
NSCLC eligible for definitive local therapy alone.
Another primary cancer within 3 years, unless curatively treated with low recurrence risk.
Symptomatic brain metastases or spinal cord compression.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or suspected ILD not ruled out by imaging.
